name: Mobile
geoReference: Mobile River, Mobile Bay, Dog River, and Three Mile Creek; I-10, I-65, I-165, US-90, US-98, US-43, US-45, AL-163, and Airport Blvd.
pickupNotes: Active primary market across City of Mobile corporate limits. City biweekly curbside trash has a 2 cu yd limit and excludes Freon appliances, TVs, electronics, tires, contractor debris, and commercial cleanouts.
notes: Primary market stated in the project brief.

name: Prichard
geoReference: Immediately north of Mobile along I-65, I-165, US-45 (St. Stephens Rd), and US-43 (Telegraph Rd).
pickupNotes: Separate municipality north of Mobile; City of Mobile trash and drop-off rules do not apply. Verify current bulk rules with Prichard Public Works.
notes: Research target. Do not publish until owner approves coverage.

name: Saraland
geoReference: North Mobile metro along I-65 (Exits 13 & 15), US-43, and AL-158 (Industrial Pkwy) near Bayou Sara and Chickasabogue Creek.
pickupNotes: City of Saraland bulk/yard rules exclude electronics, TVs, untagged Freon appliances, and contractor debris.
notes: Research target awaiting owner coverage confirmation.

name: Chickasaw
geoReference: North border of Mobile along I-65, US-43 (Craft Hwy), Viaduct Rd, and Chickasabogue Creek.
pickupNotes: Incorporated city bordering Mobile and Prichard; verify municipal bulk rules with Chickasaw City Hall.
notes: Research target awaiting owner coverage confirmation.

name: Semmes
geoReference: Western Mobile County along US-98 (Moffett Rd), AL-158, and Schillinger Rd N near the Big Creek Lake watershed.
pickupNotes: Residents contract private haulers for regular garbage; Semmes Public Works twice-monthly bulk pickup (3 cu yd cap) excludes appliances, electronics, tires, paint, and C&D debris.
notes: Research target awaiting owner coverage confirmation.

name: Satsuma
geoReference: North Mobile metro along US-43 and I-65 (Exit 19) between Saraland and Creola.
pickupNotes: City brush/debris pickup (2 cu yd limit) excludes contractor C&D debris; Freon appliances require proper tagging.
notes: Research target awaiting owner coverage confirmation.

name: Citronelle
geoReference: Northern Mobile County upland pine ridge along US-45 (~30 miles northwest of Downtown Mobile).
pickupNotes: Longer haul distance from central Mobile; verify municipal bulk rules with Citronelle Public Works.

name: Bayou La Batre
geoReference: Southern coastal Mobile County along AL-188 and tidal Bayou La Batre on Mississippi Sound.
pickupNotes: Coastal working-waterfront municipality; verify current municipal bulk/appliance rules with Bayou La Batre City Hall.

name: Creola
geoReference: Northeast Mobile County along US-43 and I-65 (Exit 22) adjacent to the Mobile-Tensaw River Delta.
pickupNotes: Contracted municipal sanitation excludes contractor C&D debris and hazardous waste.

name: Dauphin Island
geoReference: Barrier island at the mouth of Mobile Bay and Mississippi Sound via AL-193 (Gordon Persons Bridge).
pickupNotes: Elevated coastal/pilings homes, external stairs, and bridge travel considerations; private subscription garbage haulers.

name: Mount Vernon
geoReference: Northeastern Mobile County along US-43 near the Mobile River (~28 miles north of Mobile).
pickupNotes: Monthly town bulk/yard schedule excludes C&D debris; regional Chastang Sanitary Landfill (17045 Hwy 43) is located in Mount Vernon.

name: Theodore
geoReference: South of Mobile along I-10, US-90, Bellingrath Rd, Theodore Dawes Rd, Theodore Industrial Canal, and Fowl River.
pickupNotes: Unincorporated Mobile County CDP — no municipal curbside bulk collection (residents hire private haulers and cannot use City of Mobile resident-only drop-offs).

name: Tillman's Corner
geoReference: Southwest Mobile crossroads at I-10, US-90 (Government Blvd), Schillinger Rd S, and AL-193 (Rangeline Rd).
pickupNotes: Core CDP is unincorporated Mobile County (private garbage subscription required), though small adjacent pockets have been annexed into Mobile city limits.

name: Eight Mile
geoReference: Northwest of Downtown Mobile along US-45 (St. Stephens Rd) and AL-217 (Lott Rd).
pickupNotes: Split jurisdiction in 36613: eastern/commercial portions were annexed into the City of Prichard, while western/northern stretches along Lott Rd remain unincorporated Mobile County.
notes: Split Prichard / unincorporated Mobile County community.

name: Grand Bay
geoReference: Southwestern Mobile County near the Mississippi state line along I-10 (Exit 4), US-90, and Grand Bay Wilmer Rd.
pickupNotes: Unincorporated rural/residential CDP; private garbage haulers required.

name: Irvington
geoReference: Southwestern Mobile County along US-90, I-10 (Exit 10), and Irvington-Bayou La Batre Hwy (CR-39).
pickupNotes: Unincorporated community with larger rural lots, outbuildings, and private waste-hauler subscriptions.

name: Bay Minette
geoReference: Baldwin County seat in North Baldwin along US-31, AL-59, AL-225, and I-65 east of the Mobile-Tensaw River Delta.
pickupNotes: Partnered with SWDA of Baldwin County for weekly 95-gal cart garbage and monthly scheduled bulky/yard pickup (no contractor C&D debris); Bay Minette Transfer Station is on Nicholsville Rd.
notes: Baldwin County seat — initial expansion inventory.

name: Daphne
geoReference: Mobile Bay Eastern Shore along I-10, US-98, Scenic Hwy 98, and AL-181 across D'Olive and Tiawasee Creeks.
pickupNotes: City of Daphne Public Works handles residential cart garbage, yard debris, bulk household items (no contractor debris), and single-stream recycling (no glass or plastic bags). Note: unincorporated Belforest also uses Daphne 36526 mailing addresses.
notes: Priority Eastern Shore target — activate in Command Center once owner confirms Eastern Shore dispatch.

name: Elberta
geoReference: East-central Baldwin County along US-98, AL-83, and CR-83 north of Wolf Bay and Perdido Bay.
pickupNotes: Verify municipal bulk rules with Town of Elberta Public Works; SWDA Eastfork C&D Landfill (29751 Eastfork Landfill Rd) sits in Elberta.

name: Fairhope
geoReference: Mobile Bay Eastern Shore bluffs along US-98, Scenic Hwy 98, AL-104, and AL-181 across Fly Creek and Cowpen Creek.
pickupNotes: City of Fairhope Public Works caps curbside bulk at 2.5 cu yd/week (no contractor debris or paint); Fairhope CHaRM drop-off is at 20609 Bishop Rd. Unincorporated Barnwell and Battles Wharf share 36532.
notes: Priority Eastern Shore target — activate in Command Center once owner confirms Eastern Shore dispatch.

name: Foley
geoReference: South Baldwin commercial gateway at AL-59, US-98, and the Foley Beach Express near Bon Secour River and Wolf Bay.
pickupNotes: Foley Public Works Sanitation runs residential garbage, recycling (no glass/plastic bags), and limb/bulk pickup (6 cu yd/week limb cap; no contractor debris).

name: Gulf Shores
geoReference: Gulf of Mexico, Gulf Intracoastal Waterway (GIWW), and Little Lagoon at AL-59, AL-182 (Perdido Beach Blvd), and AL-180 (Fort Morgan Rd).
pickupNotes: High concentration of condos, vacation rentals, elevator HOA buildings, and elevated beach homes. Republic Services handles cart garbage/recycling; City Public Works collects residential bulk/yard debris (no contractor debris).

name: Loxley
geoReference: Central Baldwin logistics crossroads at I-10 (Exit 44), US-90, AL-59, and the Baldwin Beach Express.
pickupNotes: City of Loxley Public Works & Utilities manages residential garbage and scheduled limb/bulk trash; SWDA MacBride C&D Landfill (26941 McBride Rd) is in Loxley.
notes: Transitioned from Town to City of Loxley following 2020 Census.

name: Magnolia Springs
geoReference: South-central Baldwin along US-98 and CR-49 centered on the oak-canopied Magnolia River.
pickupNotes: Partnered with SWDA of Baldwin County for residential garbage and monthly Town-Wide Bulky Waste Pick-Up (no C&D debris). Narrow oak-lined residential lanes require careful truck access.

name: Orange Beach
geoReference: Gulf of Mexico, Perdido Pass, Wolf Bay, Bayou St. John, and GIWW along AL-182, AL-161, and the Foley Beach Express.
pickupNotes: High-rise condos, marina properties, and resort HOA loading/elevator rules. Orange Beach CHaRM (22510 Russian Rd) accepts residential e-waste/HHW.

name: Perdido Beach
geoReference: Northern shore of Perdido Bay and Soldier Creek south of US-98 via CR-97.
pickupNotes: Shares 36530 postal ZIP with Elberta; partnered with SWDA of Baldwin County on individual residential accounts for weekly garbage and scheduled bulky/yard pickup.

name: Robertsdale
geoReference: Central Baldwin hub at AL-59, US-90, AL-104, and the Baldwin Beach Express.
pickupNotes: City of Robertsdale Public Works operates residential garbage and separate limb/non-household trash pickup (no contractor C&D debris).

name: Silverhill
geoReference: Central Baldwin crossroads at AL-104 and CR-55 between Fairhope and Robertsdale.
pickupNotes: Verify current municipal bulk and limb pickup rules directly with Silverhill Town Hall.

name: Spanish Fort
geoReference: Northern Eastern Shore overlooking Mobile Bay and the Blakeley/Apalachee Rivers at I-10, US-90/98 (Battleship Pkwy), US-31, and AL-225.
pickupNotes: Closest Baldwin County municipality to Downtown Mobile across the I-10 Bayway/Causeway. Contracted Waste Pro residential bulk/appliance pickup is limited to 2 times per year by request (no C&D debris).
notes: Priority Eastern Shore target — activate in Command Center once owner confirms Eastern Shore dispatch.

name: Summerdale
geoReference: Central Baldwin along AL-59 and CR-32 between Robertsdale and Foley.
pickupNotes: Partnered with SWDA of Baldwin County for weekly garbage and monthly bulky/yard pickup; SWDA Magnolia Sanitary Landfill, MRF, and Magnolia CHaRM sit in rural Summerdale (36580).

name: Belforest
geoReference: Inland Eastern Shore residential/agricultural community east of Daphne along AL-181, CR-64, and CR-13.
pickupNotes: Unincorporated Baldwin County (uses Daphne 36526 mailing addresses, but served by SWDA of Baldwin County rather than City of Daphne Public Works).
notes: Required unincorporated Baldwin County research record.

name: Historic Marlow
geoReference: Historic Fish River crossing community along CR-9 near Marlow Ferry Park between Fairhope/Point Clear and Summerdale/Foley.
pickupNotes: Unincorporated Baldwin County community served by SWDA residential garbage and monthly request-based bulk pickup.
notes: Required unincorporated Baldwin County research record.

name: Fish River
geoReference: Waterfront and rural residential corridor along the 28.9-mile Fish River across AL-104, CR-32, CR-9, and the US-98 Fish River Bridge into Weeks Bay.
pickupNotes: Unincorporated waterfront homes, boathouses, elevated structures, and long private drives; governed by Baldwin County / SWDA.
notes: Required unincorporated Baldwin County research record.

name: Barnwell
geoReference: Southern Eastern Shore community along US-98 southeast of Point Clear and west of Fish River / Weeks Bay Reserve.
pickupNotes: Unincorporated community carrying a Fairhope 36532 mailing address; governed by Baldwin County / SWDA rather than City of Fairhope.
notes: Required unincorporated Baldwin County research record.

name: Battles Wharf
geoReference: Historic Mobile Bay waterfront community along Scenic Highway 98 between Fairhope and Point Clear.
pickupNotes: Bayfront lots and private oak-canopied drives in unincorporated 36532; served by SWDA of Baldwin County.
notes: Required unincorporated Baldwin County research record.

name: Point Clear
geoReference: Prominent Mobile Bay waterfront community and Census-Designated Place along Scenic Highway 98 south of Fairhope.
pickupNotes: Unincorporated CDP (36564 / 36532) with bayfront estates, boardwalks, and gated/private drives; served by SWDA of Baldwin County.
notes: Required unincorporated Baldwin County research record.

name: Montrose
geoReference: Historic red-clay bluff community on Mobile Bay along US-98 and Scenic Highway 98 wedged between Daphne and Fairhope.
pickupNotes: Unincorporated pocket between Daphne and Fairhope; street addresses often carry Daphne or Fairhope postal cities while falling under Baldwin County / SWDA jurisdiction.
notes: Required unincorporated Baldwin County research record.

name: Bon Secour
geoReference: Historic fishing and riverfront community along the Bon Secour River and CR-49 / CR-10 between Foley and Gulf Shores.
pickupNotes: Unincorporated CDP served by SWDA of Baldwin County.

name: Lillian
geoReference: Western shore of Perdido Bay along US-98 at the Lillian Bridge on the Florida state line.
pickupNotes: Unincorporated Perdido Bay CDP served by SWDA of Baldwin County.

name: Stapleton
geoReference: North Baldwin corridor at US-31 and AL-59 between Spanish Fort/Loxley and Bay Minette.
pickupNotes: Unincorporated CDP served by SWDA of Baldwin County.

name: Fort Morgan
geoReference: 22-mile barrier peninsula extending west from Gulf Shores along AL-180 (Fort Morgan Rd) between Mobile Bay and the Gulf of Mexico.
pickupNotes: Elevated pilings beach homes, narrow sand drives, and extended travel along AL-180; unincorporated 36542 governed by Baldwin County / SWDA.

name: Stockton
geoReference: Historic North Baldwin delta community along AL-59 and I-65 (Exit 31) north of Bay Minette.
pickupNotes: Unincorporated rural CDP served by SWDA of Baldwin County.
